name: LogoCreator
description: Design a brand-ready logo and export a full brand kit — a built-in vector engine that needs no key and no network, plus optional AI marks that run on the image providers you already connected in Astravia.
tab.label: LogoCreator
agent.logoMaster.name: LogoCreator
agent.logoMaster.description: Designs logos, chooses the structure and palette, and hands over a complete brand kit — a vector engine that needs no key, plus AI marks when asked.
panel.title: LogoCreator
panel.subtitle: A logo canvas: mark, lockup, palette and a complete brand kit, all in one panel.
label.subject: Mark:
placeholder.intent: a minimal leaf mark, organic and calm
type.iconName.hint: A pictorial mark above the wordmark.
type.icon.hint: The mark alone — app icon, avatar, favicon.
type.wordmark.hint: Typography only, with an accent rule.
type.monogram.hint: Initials drawn from a geometric stroke alphabet.
type.emblem.hint: A badge with the name set on the arc.
style.minimal.hint: One shape, generous space, thick even strokes.
style.geometric.hint: Precise polygons on a grid, sharp corners.
style.gradient.hint: A smooth two-tone gradient across the mark.
style.mascot.hint: A friendly character with a rounded ring.
style.handDrawn.hint: Slightly irregular strokes and paper grain.
style.luxury.hint: Thin strokes, wide tracking, fine double ring.
style.threeD.hint: Soft volume with a depth offset behind the mark.
hint.localEngine: The built-in engine draws this as real vector paths — no key, no network, and every design is reproducible from its numbers.
hint.aiMode: The AI path returns a raster image. It exports as PNG only and cannot be rebuilt at a larger size.
action.surprise: Surprise me — one mark per style
gallery.title: Your logos
kit.title: Brand kit
kit.failed: The brand kit could not be built
kit.guideHint: Open brand-guide.html in the zip, then Print → Save as PDF.
kit.aiNote: This design came from the AI engine, so it is a raster image: no SVG, no variants, no brand guide. Use the AI engine for exploration and the built-in engine for anything you will ship.
ai.title: AI image source
ai.description: The built-in engine needs nothing. AI marks spend one of the image providers you already connected in Astravia — there is no key to paste here.
ai.noneBody: No image provider in Astravia can generate from text yet. Add one in Astravia's own settings, then press refresh — this plugin does not keep its own keys.
ai.cost: Every AI generation is billed by that provider to your own account. The vector engine costs nothing.
ai.engineNote: AI results are raster images: PNG only, no SVG, no brand guide, and they cannot be rebuilt at a larger size.
ai.denied: This plugin has not been granted the image permission yet. Open Settings → Abilities → Plugins → LogoCreator and re-authorise it — an update never grants a permission the previous version did not already hold.
